questions.prompt: Graph y = 8(1/2)ˣ. Drag two points that are on the graph (use whole-number x-values).
solutionSteps: At x = 0, y = a = 8, so (0, 8) is on the graph.
Each step right multiplies y by 1/2: (0, 8), (1, 4), (2, 2), (3, 1).
The graph falls and approaches the x-axis on the right.
